subject.title: [Feature]: Support OpenAI GPT-Live (gpt-live-1) full-duplex realtime voice models

question: Should OpenClaw expose the pre-GA quicksilver protocol now, and if so should selection be explicit or inferred from `gpt-live-*` model names?
rationale: Implementing this before public API documentation creates a new provider contract, while the inspected Codex reference selects quicksilver through protocol version v1 rather than model naming.

options.title: Wait for public API
options.body: Keep GA Realtime supported and add an actionable unsupported-model error until OpenAI publishes the stable GPT-Live contract.

options.title: Add explicit preview mode
options.body: Implement quicksilver behind a clearly named preview protocol selector with successful entitlement proof and no default change.

options.title: Infer from model name
options.body: Automatically select quicksilver for `gpt-live-*`, accepting coupling to an unconfirmed naming convention.

recommendation.title: Wait for public API
recommendation.body: Keep GA Realtime supported and add an actionable unsupported-model error until OpenAI publishes the stable GPT-Live contract.

likelyOwner.reason: The current realtime voice implementation and most of its feature history are directly connected to this person.
